standard_prerequisites.name: Definition of a w-local spectral space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the definition of a w-local spectral space through its set of closed points and the specialization behaviour
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the two properties to be verified for the closed subspace: the closed points form a closed set and every point specializes to a unique closed point.

core_obligations: Identify the closed points (proof lines 425-427): the set Y_0 of closed points of Y equals the intersection of Y with the closed point set X_0 of X, hence is closed in Y.

Verify the specialization property (proof lines 427-430): since X is w-local, any y in Y specializes to a unique point of X_0; that specialization lies in the closure of y, which is contained in the closed subset Y, hence the specialization belongs to Y and therefore to Y_0.
Conclude (proof lines 430-430): the two defining properties hold for Y, so Y is w-local.
proof_roadmap: Cut the closed point set of the ambient space down to the closed subspace.
Use that the closure of a point of the subspace stays inside it to relocate the unique specialization.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a closed subspace of a w-local spectral space is again w-local (statement lines 419-423). The proof (proof lines 425-431) identifies the closed points of the subspace as the trace of the closed points of the ambient space and shows that the unique specialization of any point lands inside the subspace. H2: two verifications, written out in full.
